sha256-fd-v1:0f584509a869bef759bc887da46.description: A short AliceSoft command adventure starring a policewoman. Originally distributed with early releases of Rance, it stands as a compact side story rather than a full-length RPG.
sha256-fd-v1:0f584509a869bef759bc887da46.title: Fukei-san VX

sha256-fd-v1:0f76d3fefeae2d4674d18d57dd0.description: Assemble adventurers in Utsuro and descend the Black Tower to seek an artifact said to grant eternal youth. Map its first-person maze, manage the party, and survive turn-based encounters.
sha256-fd-v1:0f76d3fefeae2d4674d18d57dd0.title: The Black Onyx

sha256-hdi-v1:0fe741a7207ddb1fd64751070d.description: Choose one of three heroes for a board-based strategy RPG journey. The computer directs the other two as the group faces roaming monsters and rival forces.
sha256-hdi-v1:0fe741a7207ddb1fd64751070d.title: Innocent Tour
